memory_update.text: PAR Technology is a high-priority underfollowed candidate for the restaurant ordering, loyalty, POS, and customer-data stack because restaurant technology is core to its product portfolio and market cap is within the preferred discovery range.

node: Delivery, ordering, loyalty, and customer-data stack
summary: Layer 1B expanded the public-market universe around restaurant ordering, POS, loyalty, payments, and guest-data infrastructure. The most direct pure-play public proxy, Olo, was removed from the active US-listed candidate set because Thoma Bravo completed its acquisition on 2025-09-12 and Olo ceased NYSE trading. The remaining investable map is split between a reference leader, Toast, and underfollowed smaller restaurant-tech infrastructure names such as PAR Technology, NCR Voyix, and Lightspeed Commerce. The chokepoint thesis remains that restaurant brands and franchisees need first-party ordering, loyalty, POS integrations, payments, and guest identity tools to reduce aggregator dependency and preserve ownership of customer data.
